summary: Verified NEW features: (1) Group chats end-to-end and (2) Online / last-seen presence. Backend pytest suite (12/12) covers auth + friendship setup, group creation with non-friend filtering, 403 for non-members, 400 for empty name/body, send/list/detail flows, read-tracking (unread decrements after GET detail), and presence propagation via /api/auth/me touching users.last_active_at and /api/dm/threads + /api/friends returning it. Frontend Playwright walk-through (mobile viewport 390x844): logged in as member1@gmail.com, dismissed onboarding tour, tapped inbox-new-group -> /group/new, filled group-name, selected friend via grp-sel-<id>, tapped group-create -> navigated to /group/[id] with '2 members' header, typed in group-input, tapped group-send, message bubble 'TEST_hello_ui' appeared. Returned to Inbox: GROUPS section shows the new group; FRIENDS row shows a green online dot + 'Active now' for member2 confirming presence UI. No red-screen, no console errors related to groups/presence. NOTE: SQUARE_ENV=production in backend/.env — did NOT trigger any payment/Square flows as instructed.

issues: Onboarding modal (Find your class / Skip) overlays the Inbox tab button and blocks tapping tab icons until dismissed. On a fresh session the user must tap 'Skip' before they can reach the inbox from the tab bar. Not a group/presence bug — reporting as UX friction only.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Harmless on web preview but noisy — consider guarding useNativeDriver with Platform.OS !== 'web'.

Console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not from the group/inbox screens directly but worth cleaning up in shared components/theme.

action_items: Optional: On the /group/new screen, dim/disable the 'Create group' button while no friend is selected (currently it Alerts 'Add friends' — works but a disabled state would be more discoverable).
Optional: Silence useNativeDriver warning on web and migrate remaining shadow*/pointerEvents style props to their non-deprecated forms.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py group_create silently drops non-friend member_ids without informing the caller. Behavior is correct/safe (documented in the request) but the API returns only {group_id} so the client can't detect that some ids were filtered. Consider returning {group_id, added: [...], skipped: [...]} for UX transparency.
server.py:2222 does one DB round-trip per member_id for friendship lookup. Fine at current scale (small groups) but a single $in query would scale better.

/api/groups/{gid} both marks messages read AND returns them in a single call — clients replaying the endpoint will always see zero unread from the second call onward (this is standard, just documenting).

presence is only refreshed on /api/auth/me and DM send. Consider touching last_active_at on other frequently-hit endpoints (e.g. groups_list, dm_threads themselves) so a user browsing the inbox appears online to peers even if they don't hit /auth/me for a while.
server.py is 4838 lines — well beyond the 700-line threshold; should be split into routers (auth, social, groups, dm, admin, payments, etc.) for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (login -> new group -> select friend -> create -> send message -> back to inbox -> group listed -> presence dot + 'Active now' on friend row)

seed_data_creation: Created (or logged into) member1@gmail.com, member2@gmail.com, member3@gmail.com via /api/auth/register (or login if they already existed). Established accepted friendship between member1 and member2. Created one group 'TEST_Crew_<random>' via pytest and one 'TEST_UI_Crew' via the UI, each with a TEST_ prefix for easy cleanup. Sent TEST_ messages inside those groups. Passwords used: existing 'Password123' when login succeeded, otherwise registered with 'Password123!' (backend requires a symbol).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Groups + presence are fully functional as of iteration 14. Reusable pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_groups_presence.py (run with -n 0 due to shared xdist config). Test users member1/2/3@gmail.com should already exist and be friends (m1<->m2). Frontend flow: to reach inbox after login, dismiss the onboarding tour ('Skip' text) first, or route directly to /inbox. SQUARE_ENV=production — do NOT hit payments endpoints from tests.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification only; no bugs found.
